description: This file defines internal structures, macros, and includes for the WPA control interface, specifically for private use within the nl80211 subsystem. It includes a struct for the interface, macros for calling handlers safely, and licensing information.

methods.name: CALL_INTF
methods.description: Macro to call an interface handler if the interface and handler are not null

methods.name: CALL_INTF_NA
methods.description: Macro to call an interface handler without additional arguments if the interface and handler are not null
